_description: Structured JSON the LLM (Bedrock) review step is asked to return. Stored in DynamoDB/S3 and used to build the Grafana annotation text and SNS/Slack notification.
explanation: Commit a1b2c3d removed the retry cap in bad_app.py's downstream call handling, allowing unbounded retries under load. This aligns with the latency spike observed starting at 14:32Z.
suggested_action: Re-add the retry cap / backoff limit removed in a1b2c3d and redeploy.
